_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. These definitions are neutral placeholders, not taken from any standard or building code. Check them against the standard that applies to the project before any figure is used.

net._doc: Floor area of a space. boundary: 'wallInnerFace' measures to the inside face of the surrounding walls; 'wallCentreline' measures to the wall centrelines.

useful._doc: Useful area of a space = its net area x the factor for its space type. Every factor is 1 (useful = net) until the correct reduction factors are entered here. TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER.

gross._doc: space: gross area attributed to one space, 'wallCentreline' (net plus half of each surrounding wall) or 'wallInnerFace' (same as net). storey: gross area of the whole storey, 'wallOuterFace' (to the outside face of the outermost walls) or 'wallCentreline'.

_outdoorSpaceTypes: Open-air space types, such as private yards in front of the ground floor: listed with their area but not counted in the storey's net, useful or gross area. TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER.
